claim: The proof of `commutator_sup_left` works in `M := H ⊔ K ⊔ N`. It then needs two `suffices`, the new helper `commutator_le_of_le` for `hHNM`/`hKNM`, and a `convert normal_subgroupOf_of_le_normalizer ...` with an eight-hint `simp` to show that `⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆` is normal in `M`. Choosing `M` as the normalizer of `⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆` makes the normality the library instance `normal_in_normalizer`, and the proof shrinks.
requested_change:
Restructure the proof with `M := normalizer (⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆)`:
```
  let M := normalizer ((⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ : Subgroup G) : Set G)
  have hHKN : ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ ≤ N := sup_le (commutator_le_right H N) (commutator_le_right K N)
  have hHM : H ≤ M := by grw [le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right, hHKN, ← le_sup_left]
  have hKM : K ≤ M := by grw [le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right, hHKN, ← le_sup_right]
  have hNM : N ≤ M := (le_inf (normalizer_commutator_ge_right H N)
    (normalizer_commutator_ge_right K N)).trans (inf_normalizer_le_normalizer_sup _ _)
  have : (⁅H.subgroupOf M, N.subgroupOf M⁆ ⊔ ⁅K.subgroupOf M, N.subgroupOf M⁆).Normal := by
    convert normal_in_normalizer (H := ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆)
    simpa [← map_subtype_inj, map_sup, map_commutator, hHM, hKM, hNM, M] using
      (le_normalizer : ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ ≤ M)
  simpa [← map_subtype_inj, map_sup, map_commutator, hHM, hKM, hNM] using
    commutator_sup_left' (H.subgroupOf M) (K.subgroupOf M) (N.subgroupOf M)
```
The proof no longer uses `commutator_le_of_le`.
evidence: lean_verify_edit on Commutator/Basic.lean, replacing lines 337-355 (the body of commutator_sup_left) with the 13-line proof above: outcome compiled. The PR's version is 19 lines.
